exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Russian Twist
Novice
1
Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.

Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
3

4
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.

1
Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
2
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the kettlebell down towards the ground.
3
As the kettlebell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
4
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the kettlebell on the opposite side of your body.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Box Squat
Beginner
1
Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell in a goblet position.
2
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
3
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Box Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Kickstand Squat
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold kettlebell in a goblet position.
2
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
3
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Kickstand Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Swing Lunge
Intermediate
1
Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Kettlebell at your side.
2
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
3
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
4
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold a kettlebell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
2
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
3
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Lateral Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold one kettlebell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
2
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
3
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Lateral Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Reverse Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold two kettlebells by your side.
2
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
3
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Forward Lunge
Intermediate
1
Stand tall, holding kettlebells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
2
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
3
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Forward Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
Beginner
1
Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
2
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
3
Hold the stick in your right arm, kettlebell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
4
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge
Advanced
1
Stand on a platform, kettlebells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
2
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
3
Push through front foot, return to start.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Staggered Waiters Bow
Intermediate
1
Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
2
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
3
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
4
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Staggered Waiters Bow

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Deficit Reverse Lunge
Intermediate
1
Stand on a platform, kettlebells in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
2
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
3
Push through front foot, return to start.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Deficit Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Waiters Bow
Intermediate
1
Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Waiters Bow

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Quad Stomp
Advanced
1
Place your foot on a plate or a low box. Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
2
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
3
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Quad Stomp

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell in a goblet position.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Hang Clean And Press
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
2
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
3
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Press

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
Intermediate
1
Hold two kettlebells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
2
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing both kettlebells overhead.
3
Lower kettlebells as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Single Arm Thruster

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Swing kettlebell between legs, then pull it up to rack position.
2
Dip slightly, drive through legs, and press kettlebell overhead.
3
Lower back to rack, then swing down for next repetition.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean And Jerk

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Hang Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
2
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
3
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Jerk

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Hang Squat Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell between legs with slight knee bend and flat back.
2
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
3
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebell overhead.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Hang Squat Clean And Jerk

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell between legs with one hand, hinge slightly at hips.
2
Pull kettlebell upward to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
3
Dip at knees, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Jerk

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell in one hand at thigh level with slight knee bend.
2
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
3
Dip slightly, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Jerk

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Thruster
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
2
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead in one motion.
3
Lower kettlebell as you descend into next rep smoothly.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Thruster

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Squat Clean And Jerk
Advanced
1
Start with kettlebells between legs resting on the floor with knee bend and flat back.
2
Pull kettlebells explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
3
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebells overhead.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Squat Clean And Jerk

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Thruster
Intermediate
1
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand.
2
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
3
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the kettlebells upwards.
4
As you press the kettlebells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
5
Slowly lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Thruster

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
2
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and stable.
3
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
2
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core tight.
3
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
Intermediate
1
Hold one kettlebell at your side and place opposite foot on platform.
2
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
3
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell just above knee with slight bend in hips and knees.
2
Explosively pull kettlebell to shoulder, catching it in a partial squat.
3
Stand tall and press kettlebell overhead until arm is fully extended.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Forward Lunge
Beginner
1
Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
2
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell in front of you, squat down until your thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
3
Return to the starting position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Forward Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Step Up
Beginner
1
Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
2
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
3
Repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Step Up

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Hip Thrust
Novice
1
Sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted firmly on the floor, lean your back against the bench.
2
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
3
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Goblet Squat
Novice
1
Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders.
2
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
3
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees and keep your back straight.
3
Return to the upright position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift (Single)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Swing
Intermediate
1
Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell between your legs, with your knees slightly bent.
2
Keeping your back straight, swing the kettlebell upwards until the kettlebell is level with your chest and carefully lower.
3
Repeat
exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Lateral Lunge (Single)
Intermediate
1
Stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your back straight and hold the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
2
Take a large step to one side, holding the kettlebell low and lunge into the bent leg.
3
Return to the starting position and repeat
exercises.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge (Single)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
2
Bend forward at the hips keeping your back and knees straight and the kettlebell close to your chest.
3
Return to standing position and thrust your pelvis forward.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
Advanced
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, lifting one foot off the floor behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the lifted leg.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you extend your lifted leg behind you, keeping your back straight - holding out your arm to the side for balance.
3
Return to the upright position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Glute Bridge
Novice
1
Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
2
Pushing through the legs and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
3
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Glute Bridge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Lunge
Beginner
1
Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
2
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell behind you, squat down until your back knee touches the ground, keeping your back straight.
3
Return to the starting position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Heels Up Goblet Squat
Novice
1
Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders and the heels slightly raised on a surface.
2
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
3
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Heels Up Goblet Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge
Intermediate
1
Laying on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
2
Pushing through the bent leg and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis and the extended leg off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
3
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
Advanced
1
Sitting on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, lean your back against the bench.
2
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
3
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell just above knee with slight bend in hips and knees.
2
Explosively pull kettlebell to shoulder, catching it in a partial squat.
3
Stand tall and press kettlebell overhead until arm is fully extended.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
Intermediate
1
Hold one kettlebell at your side and place opposite foot on platform.
2
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
3
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Conventional Deadlift (Double)
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
2
Bend at hips and knees to lift kettlebells.
3
Stand tall, then lower.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Conventional Deadlift (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Snatch (Double)
Advanced
1
Begin with a two kettlebells between your legs, hinge at hips, then swing it upwards explosively.
2
As they rise, lock out arm overhead, wrist straight.
3
Control the descent, then repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Swing (Double)
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebells outside legs
2
Hinge at hips, swing kettlebells forward, then back.
3
Thrust hips to swing kettlebells upward, keeping arms straight.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Figure Four Hip Thrust
Intermediate
1
Begin seated, kettlebell on hips.
2
Lift hips, form figure four leg shape.
3
Lower, repeat thrusts.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Figure Four Hip Thrust

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Forward Lunge (Double)
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell at your side.
2
Step forward, lunge, and return.
3
Repeat with opposite leg.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Forward Lunge (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebells in front rack.
2
Step back and lunge diagonally.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)
Intermediate
1
Start with kettlebells in front rack.
2
Step forward into lunge.
3
Return to starting position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack.
2
Step sideways into a lunge position.
3
Return to start position. Repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)
Intermediate
1
Start with kettlebell in front rack.
2
Step back into lunge.
3
Return to start position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack.
2
Step sideways, lunge.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
Beginner
1
Hold kettlebells close to chest.
2
Squat down, keeping chest up.
3
Stand up, extending hips fully.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Full Swing
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
2
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and swing it overhead.
3
Extend hips and knees, lock out arms at the top.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Full Swing

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Lateral Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebells in front of you.
2
Step sideways, lunge down and let the kettlebells land between your legs.
3
Push off, return to start. Repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
Novice
1
Hold kettlebells at your side.
2
Step backward, lower body.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding kettlebells in front.
2
Hinge at hips, keeping back straight, and lower kettlebells towards ground.
3
Return to start position, squeezing glutes at the top.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Press
Intermediate
1
Begin with the kettlebell between your legs.
2
Hinge at your hips, and lift to shoulder, then press overhead.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Press

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Curtsy Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in one hand.
2
Step back, left leg behind right.
3
Return to start position. Repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curtsy Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
2
Step forward, lunge. Bringing your back knee to the floor.
3
Extend your knee and return to the starting position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Reverse Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
2
Step backward, lunge. Bring your back knee to the floor.
3
Extend your knee back into the starting position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
2
Squat, grip kettlebell, explode hips, and lift kettlebell overhead.
3
Lower kettlebell safely to start position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Swing
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs, grip with one hand, hinge at hips.
2
Swing kettlebell forcefully forward, using hip thrust, arm straight.
3
Swing kettlebell back between legs, repeat for desired reps.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Begin with feet hip-width apart, one foot forward, kettlebell between feet.
2
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and stand tall.
3
Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Staggered Swing
Intermediate
1
Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.
2
Explosively thrust hips forward, swing kettlebell to chest height.
3
Repeat for desired reps, keeping core engaged and maintaining a staggered stance for balance.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Staggered Swing

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
Beginner
1
Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
2
Bend at hips and knees, keeping back straight, and grip the kettlebell handle.
3
Lift the kettlebell by extending hips and knees, stand up straight, and return to the starting position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Swing To Upright Row
Intermediate
1
Start with a kettlebell between your legs, hinge at hips, swing it upward.
2
Lift kettlebell to chest level, elbows high, engaging shoulders.
3
Lower kettlebell back down, maintaining control. Repeat for desired reps.
exercises.name: Swing To Upright Row

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Step Up Double
Beginner
1
Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
2
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
3
Repeat.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Step Up Double

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
Advanced
1
Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell at one shoulder.
2
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up
Advanced
1
Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold kettlebells at your shoulders.
2
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Balance
Intermediate
1
Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a kettlebell in one hand
2
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
3
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Balance

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
2
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the kettlebell down towards the ground.
3
As the kettlebell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
4
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the kettlebell on the opposite side of your body.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Box Squat
Beginner
1
Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell in a goblet position.
2
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
3
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Box Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Kickstand Squat
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold kettlebell in a goblet position.
2
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
3
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.
exercises.name: Kettlebell Kickstand Squat

exercises.cardText:
Kettlebell Swing Lunge
Intermediate
1
Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Kettlebell at your side.
2
